title: Agent Message Protocol (AMP)
description: Open standard for organizational agent communication. Extends A2A/ACP with governance semantics: accountability, traceability, and semantic alignment. AMP v1.0 — Indira Réquiz, 2026.

amp_version.description: AMP protocol version. Always '1.0' for this spec.

sender.description: Organizational identity of the sending agent — not just a name or model, but a role anchored to the Ledger.

agent_id.description: Unique identifier in the organizational Ledger. Format: {org_slug}/{agent_role}/{uuid}

org_role.description: Functional role of this agent within the organization (e.g., 'financial-analysis-agent', 'content-review-agent')

permissions.description: Active permission scopes for this agent at time of message

ledger_ref.description: URI to this agent's identity entry in the organizational Ledger

intent.description:
Organizational intent of the message.
- REQUEST: Asking another agent to perform a task
- DELEGATE: Transferring full ownership of a task
- REPORT: Returning results to a requester or logging to the Ledger
- ESCALATE: Flagging a situation that exceeds the agent's scope or confidence

ephemeral_context.description: Context relevant only to this specific communication — distinct from the full history in the Ledger.

task_id.description: Ledger task ID this message is associated with

background.description: Relevant context for this communication only. Do not repeat full Ledger history here.

ovl_version.description: Version of the Organizational Vocabulary Layer active at time of sending. Receiver should verify alignment.

tools.description: Capabilities available to the receiving agent for this task. Explicit tool listing reduces scope ambiguity.

constraints.description: Limits on scope, time, resources, and reversibility for the receiving agent.

time_limit.description: ISO 8601 duration (e.g., 'PT4H' = 4 hours). Absence means no hard deadline.

scope.description: Explicit scope boundary. What the agent CANNOT do in executing this task.

reversibility.description: IRREVERSIBLE actions require pre-execution validation (human-in-the-loop or Capa 3 testing). REVERSIBLE allows post-hoc validation.

expected_output.description: Precise specification of the required result. The more specific this is, the less ontological drift occurs.

detail_level.description: SUMMARY: key result only. DETAILED: result + reasoning. FULL_TRACE: complete decision trace for Ledger entry.

completeness_criteria.description: What constitutes 'done'. Explicit criteria prevent premature task completion.

confidence.description: Sender's epistemic state about the information being transmitted. Optional but recommended for ESCALATE intents.

score.description: Confidence score from 0.0 (no confidence) to 1.0 (full confidence)

basis.description: What grounds this confidence level (e.g., 'verified against 3 independent sources', 'extrapolated from incomplete data')

ephemeral_context.background: Q1 revenue analysis requested by CFO. Data from Snowflake warehouse, period Jan-Mar 2026.

constraints.scope: Read-only access to financial data. No external API calls. No email transmission.

expected_output.completeness_criteria: Report includes revenue by product line, YoY comparison, and at least 3 variance explanations with supporting data.

confidence.basis: Data source is primary system of record, verified connection at task start

ephemeral_context.background: Customer ticket #98234. Standard resolution attempts failed. Customer mentions contract violation. Context: 4 prior interactions, 2 failed resolution attempts, customer is enterprise tier.

expected_output.completeness_criteria: Resolution decision with legal team sign-off if contract terms are involved.

confidence.basis: Situation involves contract interpretation outside agent's training scope
